name: Tolarian Academy
description: Urza's academy, whose people battle a Phyrexian infestation on the island while he is away.

description_citations.text: "Urza's Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza enlists Barrin as headmaster, and they found the Tolarian Academy around 3285 AR.
timeline.quote: they founded the Tolarian Academy around 3285 AR

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi creates Teferi's Drakes at the Tolarian Academy, and Barrin uses them to defend the university against Kerrick's forces.
timeline.quote: they were used by Barrin in the defense of the University against Kerrick 's forces.

citation.text: "Drake", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira befriends Karn and names him.
timeline.quote: she was Karn 's first friend after his activation and gave him his name

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Academy years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin found the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria, admitting only children.
timeline.quote: Urza and Barrin founded the Tolarian Academy

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The time machine fails catastrophically, destroying the academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape.
timeline.quote: destroying the academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape.

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Tolarian Temporal Disaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin found the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria.
timeline.quote: founded on the island of Tolaria by Urza and Barrin in 3285 AR

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza founds the Tolarian Academy as Master Malzra, gathering talented scholars including Barrin, Teferi and Rayne.
timeline.quote: Under the pseudonym "Master Malzra," Urza summoned the most talented artificers

citation.text: "Urza", section "Tolaria and the Time Streams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza creates Karn by implanting Xantcha's heartstone in a silver golem.
timeline.quote: By implanting Xantcha's heartstone (her only remains) into a silver golem , Urza created Karn

citation.text: "Urza", section "Tolaria and the Time Streams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Tolarian Temporal Disaster destroys most of the Academy and kills hundreds after Karn is sent back to prevent a Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: The Tolarian Temporal Disaster destroyed the majority of the Tolarian Academy, killing hundreds of inhabitants

citation.text: "Urza", section "Tolaria and the Time Streams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza rebuilds the Academy and uses its temporal rifts for fast-time research.
timeline.quote: Urza eventually rebuilt the Academy

citation.text: "Urza", section "Tolaria and the Time Streams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza creates the Metathran army using genetic stock from around the world infused with magic; Barrin contests his methods and researchers quit.
timeline.quote: Barrin began openly contesting Urza's methods while some researchers outright quit the project

citation.text: "Metathran", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin saves Urza, Multani becomes trapped within him, and Multani later helps destroy Kerrick and his Negators during the Invasion of Tolaria.
timeline.quote: Multani aided Urza in destroying Kerrick and all his minions

citation.text: "Urza", section "Atonement for Past Sins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: While Urza is away, the people of the Tolarian Academy battle a Phyrexian infestation on the island.
timeline.quote: the people of his Tolarian Academy have to battle a Phyrexian infestation on the island itself.

citation.text: "Urza's Legacy", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The academy manipulates marriages between families strong in white mana, including the Capashen and Sisay's ancestors.
timeline.quote: the academy soon had almost complete control over who wedded whom

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "First Phase". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin returns to Tolaria and casts a spell he vowed never to cast, destroying the island, the Phyrexians, the academy and himself.
timeline.quote: Barrin cast a spell he had vowed never to cast

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Obliteration". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin's Obliterate destroyed the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria, leaving ruins.
timeline.quote: but it was destroyed in the wake of the massive, final spell of Barrin, Master Wizard

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Enthril reveals he graduated top of his class from the academy Boldt is bound for.
timeline.quote: Graduated top honors.

citation.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerers" by Mark Price. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Boldt finds Enthril's signet ring, puts it on, and lets the winds carry him away from the Tolarian Academy.
timeline.quote: He put on Enthril's ring, as a reminder.

citation.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerers" by Mark Price. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana recalls being ordered to dismantle the Academy and purge invention from the city.
timeline.quote: To dismantle the Academy, to purge the pursuit of invention and innovation from the city.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo tells Daretti the Academy is dead, Muzzio exiled and cogwork outlawed, and urges him to act like a hyena.
timeline.quote: Well, the academy is dead and Muzzio is exiled.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Docent Thranegeld tests Ulf, finds he is no Phyrexian, and sets him to research Corondor secretly.
timeline.quote: "Corondor," Thranegeld growled.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: After weeks of searching, Ulf finds a mildewed book about Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor, and Dihada's curse.
timeline.quote: Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ulf shows the book to Silas Brotten, who wants him to leave it with him, but Ulf refuses.
timeline.quote: Ulf hesitated, then shook his head. "I don't think I can, sir."

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Thranegeld tells Ulf to hide the book and share it only when they know who their friends are.
timeline.quote: "When the time's ripe and when we're sure of who our friends are, we'll share it."

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ulf hides the book in the stables and returns to find his three roommates murdered.
timeline.quote: He had been dismembered, the pieces of him piled in a careful stack near the wall.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ulf finds Thranegeld dead in his chambers.
timeline.quote: the dwarf tilted and slid from the chair and onto the floor.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Brotten's face splits, revealing a Phyrexian, and he demands the book as Ulf flees.
timeline.quote: A Phyrexian , Ulf realized with horror.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Brotten and an infected student chase Ulf through the academy, killing students, until Ulf is cornered at a dead end.
timeline.quote: He tried to turn back, but it was too late.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A viashino bursts through the wall to save Ulf and holds Brotten back.
timeline.quote: "Run!" he said to Ulf. "Find him!

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A grizzled swordsman beheads the infected student who finds Ulf hiding in the library, and removes a tracker from Ulf.
timeline.quote: Standing over the body of the student was a grizzled man.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The man kills five Phyrexian sleeper agents waiting outside the library with flame.
timeline.quote: "Yes, let's," said a deep voice behind them.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jared finds the dead viashino who had saved Ulf and swears his sacrifice will not be in vain.
timeline.quote: "You fought honorably, old friend," he murmured

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Brotten confronts the pair in the vestibule, names Jared Carthalion, and says Jared was always the prize.
timeline.quote: You were always the prize, Carthalion.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jared kills Brotten, who says Dihada is waiting for him.
timeline.quote: "She's waiting for you, Jared. Return to her."

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jared sends Ulf with the book to Corondor while he returns to the academy.
timeline.quote: "You will take the book to safety. Bring it to Corondor.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The archmage reveals himself to be a gray-skinned tentacled woman, pleased that Jared found the book.
timeline.quote: "How lucky you found the book, Jared.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: In 4562 Dihada returns to Dominaria, takes the Tolarian Academy and Corondor, hoping to force Jared Carthalion into a conflict that returns Dakkon to her.
timeline.quote: In 4562, Dihada returned to Dominaria to take control of the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam .

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone Dihada disposes of the Tolarian Academy's archmage, and Ertai and the Society of Mishra later turn it into a haven for dark research.
timeline.quote: Geyadrone Dihada disposed of the Academy's archmage and took his place.

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai, resurrected as a Phyrexian, takes control of the Lat-Nam academy.
timeline.quote: took control of the academy at Lat-Nam

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "The new Tolarian Academies". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
